newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times Business - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times Business - Oct 23.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories in its Wednesday edition:
- General Motors Corp and the Canadian Automobile Workers union reached a tentative agreement on a new labor contract, ending a 20-day strike.
- Japanese authorities arrested a former copper trader for Sumitomo Corp on forgery charges.
- Pacific Gas and Electric Co plans to sell four power plants in California.
- Computer company Javelin Systems Inc will launch the first-ever public stock offering on the Internet next Friday.
